packs.name: Case Reel
packs.author: DeCombat
packs.description: Case openings spin: before the award window opens, a strip of everything the case can hold runs past a centre mark and slows down until it stops on what you got. Works for supply cases, HiSec cases and the Camo Crate; a click skips to the stop. Drawn on your own screen only: what a case gives is decided by the server before the strip starts, and nothing in play changes.

packs.name: Inspect: G36E, L96A1 and SCARs
packs.author: DeCombat
packs.description: A weapon inspect for the G36E, the L96A1, the SCAR-L (MK16, Black, Trispear and Trispear LE) and the SCAR-H, and so for every camo of them: press the inspect key and the gun turns in the hands. It is drawn on your own screen only and changes nothing in play: no stats change, no reference gun applies, and firing, reloading or switching weapons cancels it at once.
